title: Vegetarian Fish Bowl
description: A delicious and healthy vegetarian fish bowl recipe, packed with Indian spices and flavors. Serve in a hot bowl for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Fish-free tofu
ingredients.notes: Drain and press tofu before use

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: Choose a variety of colorful vegetables

ingredients.name: Indian spices
ingredients.notes: Use a blend of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

ingredients.name: Bowl
ingredients.notes: A serving bowl to hold the dish

instructions: Preheat the grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the tofu with salt and pepper, and grill for 3-4 minutes per side.
In a separate pan, heat some oil over medium heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the Indian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lime juice and cook for another minute.
To assemble the dish, place the grilled tofu on top of the vegetables.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve in a hot bowl.
If desired, add a few dashes of hot sauce on top.
